brief.text: Medical and surgical equipment providers feature prominently across today's cluster filings, with CTSO, NPCE, and ENOV all drawing purchases from multiple buyers. Director Peter Thiel’s $122.25 million purchase in PLTR represents by far the largest single transaction in the dataset, vastly exceeding the highest cluster total of $34.95 million registered by three insiders at FUN. Finally, RMIX joins ENOV in showing the broadest insider participation on the board, with an unusual cluster of five distinct insiders making purchases at each firm.
